scope: CPU read-only existing COLMAP image observations; no points3D positions/colors/errors, no RGB, no SfM

cases.limitations: Registered point IDs encode existing SfM incidence; no point positions required. Test-image observations excluded from graph and weights. Pose/SfM provenance still derives from original all-image source. Missing points3D prevents separate point-coordinate/reprojection checks, not incidence coverage.
